James, Elena,

Good to be working with you. Attaching nothing yet but our DD request list will follow separately — could you confirm the data room is open and grant access to me and Deepa Kovac? Priority areas for us are IP ownership (the motor-controller patent), the customer contracts and the cap table.

Best,
Oliver Jennings
Birchall Stone LLP
